description: Player incoming-damage formula: ordered terms, stacking rules, content/PvP adjustments, exceptions, unknowns

records.name: base_attack_vs_defense
records.expression: 공격력[attacker] × 5,000 ÷ (6,000 + 방어력[target] × (100% − 방어 관통력%[attacker]))
records.applies_to: all damage events (official text: offensive stats from attacker, defensive stats from target)
records.notes: Quoted from the official PvP formula notice (2026-06-25) and 7/2 patch note; the same order is given by MSI's reading of the official Guide (Attack × 5,000 ÷ (effective Defense + 6,000) × Damage Taken multipliers × ... × content adjustment × Skill coefficient).

records.name: stat_side_assignment
records.expression: 기본 피해량: 공격적인 능력치 = 공격자 기준, 방어적인 능력치 = 피격자 기준
records.notes: Official sentence. This is what makes the chain usable for monster→player hits: monster ATK/accuracy/crit vs player DEF/Toughness/evasion.

records.name: per_mille_internal_units
records.expression: %stats are stored ×10 (30% = 300); multiplier = (1000 + value) / 1000; '100% + 받는 피해 감소%' is computed as 1000 + 300

records.name: toughness_stacking
records.expression: actualGain = (100% − current) × added / 100%; total capped at 95% (StatTypeTable maxValueE3 950)
records.notes: IL2CPP ChainedPercentageAccumCalculator; tooltip: 'After Defense reduces incoming damage, Damage Taken Decrease reduces it further'. Order confirmed: DEF step first, then Toughness.

records.name: defense_penetration_stacking
records.expression: actualGain = (100% − current) × added / 100%; cap 100% (display max 99.9%)

records.name: evasion
records.expression: gap = max(target Evasion − attacker Accuracy, 0); miss chance = StatGapValueTable[gap]; 70% at gap ≥ 100
records.applies_to: player evading monster hits and vice versa
records.notes: Full 100-row table in stat_gap_table.json. Monster HitChance per growth-dungeon monster is in growth_dungeon_monsters.json.

records.name: critical_resistance
records.expression: effective crit rate = clamp(attacker crit − target 크리티컬 저항, 0, 100%); negative resist raises attacker crit
records.notes: Same rule in wiki Character Stats. Monster crit stats are not published (unknown whether monsters crit).

records.name: final_damage_stacking
records.expression: combined = Π(1 + FD_i) − 1

records.name: min_max_clamp
records.expression: each strike rolls between Min and Max multiplier; if Min > Max, Max is used

records.name: guild_war_excess_accuracy
records.expression: Guild War only: FD += min(max(Acc − target Eva, 0), 30) × 0.5%  (max +15%)
records.notes: Official 2/12 patch note: 내 명중이 상대 회피보다 높을수록 최종 데미지 소폭 증가, 최대 30 차이.

records.name: constants_5000_6000_for_monster_to_player
records.expression: 5,000 ÷ (6,000 + DEF×(1−pierce)) with DEF = defender's DEF
records.notes: Officially stated for PvP where the defender is a player (so player DEF does enter 5000/(6000+DEF)). For monster→player in PvE the official text only says the base chain uses attacker offense and target defense; no official PvE example and no published measurement exists. Monster attacks in co-op content add a target-Max-HP term (A×a% + H×h%) BEFORE the chain (see exceptions). Status: consistent but NOT measured; do not treat as proven.

records.name: pvp_sqrt
records.expression: 피해 = √(base chain ... × 최종 데미지%) × 스킬 계수% × 레벨 보정×2 × [PvP adjustment]

records.name: pvp_adjustment_old
records.expression: × [아레나 10,000 / 콜로세움 6,000] × 최대 HP[target] ÷ √(공격력×관통×데미지×증폭×((기공+스뎀)/2)×스탯비례×(크뎀×크확 비중)×((최소+최대)/2)×최종뎀) ÷ 1,000,000
records.notes: Bug: damage rose with target Max HP; replaced 7/2.

records.name: pvp_adjustment_new
records.expression: × C ÷ (((ATK×pierce×dmg×amp×((basic+skill)/2)×statprop×(critdmg×critweight)×((min+max)/2)×FD + 1e9)^0.23 × (MaxHP×1e8)^0.12 × ((DEF+6000)×1e12)^0.14 × ((1000+Toughness)×1e6)^0.5) ÷ 1e7) ÷ 1e6
records.notes: C = Arena 7,206,000,000 / Colosseum 4,323,600,000 / World Arena 5,764,800,000. Both offensive and defensive inputs of this adjustment use the TARGET's pre-battle stats (no active skills/buffs).

records.name: coop_sqrt
records.expression: final damage (after all stats incl. 받는 피해 감소) → square root
records.applies_to: Arena/Colosseum + 보스 레이드, 파티 퀘스트, 길드 수련장
records.notes: Official 6/22 wording. MSI (official Guide, 8/6) lists Party Quest & Boss/Guild Raid = square-root, Guild Training Ground = CUBE-root: conflict on 길드 수련장 (cube root is the later statement). Direction (player→boss vs boss→player) is not stated for PvE.

records.name: max_hp_proportional_monster_attacks
